evidence: 1:3 head-to-body chibi proportion is the cited social-readability standard for stylized 3D
wandering-spirit ambient choreography: NPCs you encounter and move past, never control
locked-camera-per-area enables high apparent population density without traversal cost

why.philosophical: Connection without combat — characters read as social presence, not threat. The world is inhabited, not contested.
why.aesthetic: Soft NPR, light-shaft-heavy atmosphere, flowing silhouettes; stylized but warm rather than clinical.
why.design: Each area is a stage you inhabit and move through, not a level you clear — the camera frames, it does not follow a fight.

locks_out: combat-driven action loop (Sky has none by design)

extrapolates_to: wandering NPCs with mood-states tied to player ritual moments
group choreography forming around Sora Tower during sequence beats
light-shaft volumetrics driven by element activation
threads_to_pull: Sky 'ascension' moment as a ritual-sequence reference
